justification: New crate: no existing crate is a general content-addressed attachment/object store; hide-state is capsule checkpoint schemas, BlobRef is a thin ref type only.
bound_statement: Storage is effectively unbounded relative to a single turn or attachment, but is always finite: bounded by configured local/cloud storage (StorageBudget), free disk, model context capability for derivatives, and user policy. Never claim literal unlimited storage.

identity.dedup: same bytes ingested twice → one ObjectRecord, two ObjectRef records

properties: stage status and bytes_processed recorded on ObjectRecord.stages
working buffer bounded by CHUNK_SIZE (262144 bytes)

large_object_proof.claim: A multi-gigabyte body need not require multi-gigabyte RAM; Receive/Persist stream at CHUNK_SIZE.
large_object_proof.fixture: synthetic 8 MiB patterned video/mp4 built in-test (not a real video)

derivative_only_boundary.law: The context-compile path can only reach derivatives, never raw object bytes blindly.

type_boundary.raw_cap: RawBytesCap — mint only at privileged host paths; not held by compile path

queue_semantics.priority: BinaryHeap by Priority (CRITICAL > HIGH > NORMAL > LOW), FIFO within priority
queue_semantics.retry: failed stage increments attempts; requeues as RetryWait until max_attempts

storage_budget.default_policy_note: bounded by configured local/cloud storage, model capability, and user policy — not unlimited
